versions.content: A blocking Rte_SwitchAck API shall return: • if the mode machine instance behaves as unconnected or • if the calling runnable runs in an exclusive area or • if no mode switch in the related mode machine instance is on- going or • when the wait point timeout occurs or • when the related ModeSwitchedAckEvent is triggered.
